messages.subject: McKesson | Executive leadership across corporate impact, regulation and stakeholder trust
messages.body:
Dear McKesson Corporate Impact Team,

McKesson operates where healthcare access, regulation, supply-chain resilience and public trust meet. That operating complexity is close to the environment in which I have built my leadership career.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. Across more than 12 years in multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations, my scope has grown across ESG and sustainability, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, social performance, compliance coordination, executive communications and strategic stakeholder engagement.

My value is strongest where senior leadership needs someone who can translate external expectations into clear internal action. I work across government, regulators, communities and business teams to surface risk early, establish accountable ownership, strengthen evidence and follow-through, and protect the institutional conditions required for investment and operations.

For McKesson, that background aligns with senior mandates spanning corporate impact, sustainability, external affairs, government relations, stakeholder strategy and international market leadership. I am internationally mobile and available on a 30-day notice period.

I have attached my executive CV. I would value consideration for a senior role where institutional credibility, responsible business and disciplined execution are central to enterprise performance.
